test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined words in the given sentence.

Can you explain to the __person hired to drive our car__, my everyday schedule?
solution:
The correct answer is Chauffeur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• Cardiologist- A doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of heart diseases and heart abnormalities.
 
• Conductor- A person who directs the performance of an orchestra or choir.
 
• Chauffeur- **Someone whose job is to drive a car** for a rich or important person. 
 
• Calligrapher- A person who is skilled at the art of calligraphy.
 
 
 
• Hence the one word that can substitute the group of words '**person hired to drive our car**' is '**chauffeur**'.
 
• Thus option 3 is the correct answer
